narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Each guava weighs three kilograms, because there are three guavas on the scale.
<bookmark mark='pile'/>Then three guavas would weigh nine kilograms together, but the scale shows only one kilogram.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Each guava must weigh much less than one kilogram, not more.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble says each guava is 3 kg; three bags of 3 kg pile up next to the scale that still reads 1 kg; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, put the three equal parts back together on the scale.
<bookmark mark='sum'/>Three thirds of a kilogram make one whole kilogram, which is what the scale showed.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; the recap board shows the check: 1/3 + 1/3 + 1/3 = 1 kg, three guavas together

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu says each guava weighs three kilograms, because there are three guavas. Three guavas would then weigh far more than the one kilogram on the scale, so the bubble is struck.
